A.spec_impact: Per-ledger as-on balances are unobtainable from the Ledger collection (SVFROMDATE hangs Tally, SVTODATE is silently ignored), so rung 1's per-ledger opening anchor during the backfill depends on probe 17's exploded ledger-level TB (decision 11) — that route is impossible, not merely unattractive. Reports (TYPE=Data) are unaffected. Rung 1 picks balance-sheet ledgers by group nature, never by 'ClosingBalance = 0' (Part 1 §6). Rung 2 compares the stock-bearing group as ledger rollup + the TB's own 'Opening Stock' row, which no ledger carries and which is NOT the Stock Summary closing total (Current Assets; Part 1 §6). Rung 1 rule (Part 1 §6): ClosingBalance is as of the period end (31-03-2026), not Tally's current date — the books reached only 20260301 before this run, so Tally's current date is before 31-Mar-2026 and the throwaway voucher was future data it still counted; the post-dated voucher wasn't found after the create, so the post-dated rule is still open. As-on reading doesn't work on the Ledger collection — SVTODATE is silently ignored (SVTODATE moved 0 of 22 balance-sheet closing balances), so ClosingBalance can only ever mean now: per-ledger opening anchors during the backfill depend on probe 17's exploded ledger-level TB (decision 11). SVFROMDATE not sent: SVFROMDATE on a Ledger collection froze Tally's XML server behind a modal (live 2026-09-23, twice) and needed a Tally restart. Opt in with `run 16 --company A --rerun --allow-risky`.

A.summary: 'isledgerwise' returns 29 ledger rows whose per-group sums equal the TB group totals (14 ms, 7341 bytes under Wine)
A.spec_impact: Rung 2 CAN compare at ledger level via {'ISLEDGERWISE': 'Yes'} — no need to stay at group level — and month-bisect gets cheaper (decision 11, R3); timing is re-measured on tier C. Caveat 1 — the response is not purely ledgers: 1 non-ledger row(s) come with it (Opening Stock), a synthetic TB row no ledger carries, so the consumer matches rows against the ledger list and skips the rest. Caveat 2 — EXPLODEALLLEVELS, EXPLODEFLAG, EXPLODEFLAG is NOT a ledger-level route (explodealllevels, explodeflag): it stops at the second group level, so ledgers under a custom sub-group never appear and its per-group sums are short by exactly those ledgers (explodealllevels: Current Liabilities; explodeflag: Current Liabilities). That hits any company with custom sub-groups.

A.summary: TB as-on 31-10-2025 is correct history; as-on 30-09-2025: bills receivable; bills payable; stock (A4 Paper Ream 500 sheets, Box File Pack of 10, HP DeskJet Printer 2723, HP Laptop 15s, Lenovo Ideapad Slim 3, Logitech Keyboard K380, Logitech Wireless Mouse, Pen Drive 32GB, Samsung 24 inch Monitor, Samsung Galaxy Tab A8, Stapler Heavy Duty, TP-Link WiFi Router AC750, USB-C Hub 7-in-1, Whiteboard Marker Set) — bills receivable, bills payable, stock match the FULL period (31-03-2026) instead, i.e. the report ignored the date it was given [Educational mode — confirm on a licensed Tally]
A.spec_impact: A Trial Balance as-on a past date IS history: Tally honours SVFROMDATE/SVTODATE on TYPE=Data reports, and every primary group reconciles to the vouchers once (a) the nominal ledger is taken from ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST only — adding the inventory ACCOUNTINGALLOCATIONS.LIST double-counts Sales/Purchase exactly 2x (reads.PROBE_POSTING_RULE) — and (b) the stock-bearing group's static `Opening Stock` row (₹18,55,800 for company A) is added to the ledger rollup. The as-on TB IS a valid parity anchor during the backfill; R30 needs no suspension on this ground (decision 11). Bills Receivable, Bills Payable and Stock Summary IGNORE the as-on date and return the books' current position: bills dated after the as-on date still appear and the totals equal the period-end anchors, and stock quantities equal opening plus the FULL period's movements. Those tiles have no month-end comparison and must be computed from vouchers, not from a dated report (Part 1 probe 18, Part 3).

history.spec_impact: A TB as-on a past date isn't history: there is no valid parity anchor while the backfill is incomplete, so parity is suspended during the backfill (R30, decision 11). Bills Receivable / Payable or Stock Summary as-on a past date aren't history: those tiles lose their month-end comparison (Part 1 probe 18, Part 3).
